headline: August is when small HVAC problems get expensive.
body_paragraph_1: Your equipment has been running at full load for weeks. Dirt and neglect are the leading causes of heating and cooling system failure, and a clogged filter forces the system to work harder to move the same air — driving up energy use and shortening equipment life.
body_paragraph_2: Filters should be checked monthly through the heavy-use months and changed at least every three months. We handle the inspection, the filters, the coils and the repairs — so nothing gets found the hard way on a 95° afternoon.
tip_headline: A Clean System Is a Cheaper System
tip_body: Replacing a dirty filter with a clean one can cut a unit's energy use by 5 to 15 percent. Pair that with a lighting and energy review and both savings land on the same bill.
note_body: Service cooling equipment in the spring and heating equipment in the fall — contractors book solid the week the weather turns.
